title: anuttarastika — anu-p06
question: Former non-being, being, action — things always, suddenly, in this existence: middle-formed, transformation-confused — whence their truth? In the non-true, unsteady, manifold, clever dream-delusion — transcending doubt, fear, stain, and reasoning's contriving: awakened, become.
